Trend
Tune the motion with `duration` and `easing`, or turn it off with `animated={false}`. Reduced motion settings turn it off automatically.
With reduced motion enabled, values update instantly with no spin.
`format` and `locales` take any `Intl.NumberFormat` options. Currency symbols, separators and signs stay still while the digits move, and non-Latin numerals spin in their own script.
`trend` sets which way digits spin. `auto` spins up when the value grows and down when it shrinks, `up` and `down` force a direction, and `shortest` takes the nearest way round the wheel.
